challenge.description: No single killer. The long dry is the boss — the waterholes shrink, the grain runs out, and everything hungry gets bold.
challenge.name: The Long Dry

covers: West/East Africa savanna: baobab parkland, tall grass, riverine wetlands

baobab hollow: The old tree feeds everything that can reach.
dry riverbed: Where the water stood, the grain remembers.
old field: Someone farmed here. The millet stayed.
tamarind shade: Cool ground, sour pods. Rest and eat.
thorn scrub: Grey bush, sweet berries. The children's harvest.

name: The Sahel and the Savanna

ruins: A roadside market. Stalls in rows under a skeleton of awning poles, a painted price board that outlived money itself. The Burn took the wiring; the bargaining echoes stayed.
A village school block. Three classrooms, one blackboard with the last lesson still on it, half-erased by rain. The desks went to firewood years ago.
A rural clinic. White paint, a red cross weathered to pink. The medicine cabinet was emptied a long time ago — but check the drawers anyway. Quietly.

scavenge.name: Sack of pearl millet
scavenge.text: A torn grain sack, half-full. The millet is dry and clean — someone stored it right.

scavenge.name: Sack of sorghum
scavenge.text: Sorghum in a woven sack. Heavy, honest, and still good.

scavenge.name: Tinned sardines
scavenge.text: Small oily fish in a tin with a faded label. The Sahel ate these by the million.

scavenge.name: Dried tilapia
scavenge.text: Sun-dried fish, stiff as boards. Soak it, stew it — the river's savings account.

scavenge.name: Bag of groundnuts
scavenge.text: Roasted groundnuts in a cloth bag. Check for mold before you feast — the bad ones go back.

scavenge.name: Salt block
scavenge.text: A dense block of salt. No calories, but everything you cook for the next month tastes like food again.

scavenge.name: Kola nuts
scavenge.text: Bitter red nuts, chewed for long days. Caffeine the old way — respect the dose.

scavenge.name: Sealed water sachet
scavenge.text: Plastic sachet of water, seal intact. The street vendors sold these by the thousand.

scavenge.name: Antimalarials (artemether)
scavenge.text: Foil blister pack, unbroken. For malaria fevers. Read the label, take the full course.

scavenge.name: Antiparasitic (mebendazole)
scavenge.text: Foil blister pack, unbroken. For worms and gut parasites. Only for those.
